title: SpaceX Launches Falcon Heavy Carrying Military Space Plane

title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Returns to Board after Investigation
text: OpenAI announced that CEO Sam Altman will rejoin the company's board of directors, months after he was briefly ousted by the previous board.

title: Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady
